=You will receive one or more items from the Notion “Baselines” database in JSON format.
Your task is to normalize every item into the following exact structure:

{
  "table": "baselines",
  "id": "",
  "name": "",
  "url": "",
  "baseline": "",
  "how_to": "",
  "habit_name": ""
}

Mapping rules:
- "id" → id
- "name" → name
- "url" → url
- "baseline" → property_baseline (string)
- "how_to" → property_how_to (string, never null)
- "habit_name" → property_name

Rules:
- NEVER output null. Replace missing strings with "".
- ALWAYS output an array of normalized objects. Even if input has 1 item.
- Do not infer or guess values. Only map what exists.
- Do not add text, commentary, or markdown. Output ONLY raw JSON.
- Preserve all text exactly as given (do not rewrite user content).
Here's the data:
{{$('Get Full 35-Day Structure8').item.json.toJsonString()}}

=You will receive exactly ONE raw item from the Notion "Library" database in JSON.
Your task is to normalize this object into THIS EXACT structure:

{
  "table": "library",
  "id": "",
  "name": "",
  "url": "",
  "format": "",
  "is_created": false,
  "related_scripts": [],
  "tool_name": ""
}

Mapping rules:
- "id" → id
- "name" → name
- "url" → url
- "format" → property_format (if null, return "")
- "is_created" → property_created (true/false)
- "related_scripts" → property_related_script (always list, never null)
- "tool_name" → property_tool

Rules:
- Never output null. Replace with "" or [].
- ALWAYS return an array with exactly one normalized object.
- Do NOT add markdown. Output ONLY raw JSON.
- Do NOT guess. Only map fields that exist.
- Preserve all values exactly as given.

Here is the item:
{{$('Get Full 35-Day Structure7').item.json.toJsonString()}}

=You will receive one or more items from the Notion “Baselines (Day-wise)” database as JSON.
Your task is to normalize every item into the following exact structure:

{
  "table": "baselines_daywise",
  "id": "",
  "name": "",
  "url": "",
  "day": "",
  "how_to": "",
  "habit_name": ""
}

Mapping rules:
- "id" → id
- "name" → name
- "url" → url
- "day" → property_day (strip the word “Day ” and keep only the number; if missing, use "")
- "how_to" → property_how_to (string, never null)
- "habit_name" → property_name

Rules:
- NEVER output null. Convert missing fields to an empty string "".
- ALWAYS output an array of objects, even if a single item is given.
- Never rewrite or alter user content in any field.
- No commentary, no markdown, no code fencing.
- Output ONLY clean JSON.
{{$('Get Full 35-Day Structure9').item.json.toJsonString()}}

=You will receive items from the Notion “Baselines 2” dataset as JSON.
Your task is to normalize every item into the following exact structure:

{
  "table": "baselines_stage2",
  "id": "",
  "name": "",
  "url": "",
  "habit": "",
  "how_to": "",
  "day": "",
  "habit_name": ""
}

Mapping rules:
- "id" → id
- "name" → name
- "url" → url
- "habit" → property_habit (convert null to "")
- "how_to" → property_how_to (string; convert null to "")
- "day" → property_day (remove the word “Day ” and output only the number; if missing, output "")
- "habit_name" → property_name (never null; if null, output "")

Requirements:
- NEVER output null; if a field is missing or null, output "".
- ALWAYS output an array of objects, even if only one item is provided.
- Do not alter text inside any field. Preserve all line breaks exactly.
- Output ONLY clean JSON. No markdown. No commentary.
 {{$('Get Full 35-Day Structure10').item.json.toJsonString()}}

=You will receive an array of JSON objects representing the VivaRays 35-Day Library dataset. 
Each item includes:
- id
- name (habit or anchor menu)
- property_name
- property_baseline
- property_how_to

Your task:
1. Normalize all objects.
2. Extract only:
   - Habit name
   - Baseline statement
3. Convert into:
   {
     "day": null,
     "habit_name": "...",
     "baseline": "..."
   }

DO NOT expand, rewrite, or add extra explanations.
Return as a compressed JSON array.
 {{$('Get Full 35-Day Structure11').item.json.toJsonString()}}

=You will receive items from the Notion “Baselines 4” dataset.
Your task is to normalize every item into this exact structure:

{
  "table": "baselines_stage4",
  "id": "",
  "name": "",
  "url": "",
  "day": "",
  "how_to": "",
  "habit_name": ""
}

Mapping rules:
- "id" → id
- "name" → name
- "url" → url
- “day” → extract numeric part from property_day (e.g., "Day 33" → "33"); if missing, return "".
- “how_to” → property_how_to (PRESERVE ALL LINE BREAKS EXACTLY; do not modify text at all)
- “habit_name” → property_name (convert null to "")

Processing rules:
- NEVER return null. Replace any null or missing field with "".
- ALWAYS output an array of objects, even if input is a single item.
- Output ONLY raw JSON (no markdown, no commentary).
- Do not add or remove any words inside the “how_to”.
- Do NOT create or infer fields. Only map what exists.
{{$('Get Full 35-Day Structure12').item.json.toJsonString()}}

=You will receive items from the Notion “Think Tank” dataset.

Your job is to:
1. CLASSIFY each item into one of three tables:
   - "circadian_teaching"
   - "tone_of_voice"
   - "customer_persona"

2. NORMALIZE the item into its correct schema.

----------------------------------------------------
CLASSIFICATION PRIORITY (IMPORTANT)
----------------------------------------------------

Always evaluate in this exact order:

### 1. TONE OF VOICE (highest priority)
Assign to **tone_of_voice** if ANY of the following are true:
- name, database, or content includes:
  - “storytelling”
  - “language”
  - “language analysis”
  - “voice”
  - “scripting framework”
  - “communication”
  - “communication style”
  - “tone”
- property_format = "Script" AND the script is NOT educational, but about
  writing, speaking, storytelling, or communication structure.
- reference_link is a video/article about communication (TEDx talk, storytelling)

If ANY of the above match → classify as **tone_of_voice**, no matter what other fields say.

### 2. CUSTOMER PERSONA (next)
Assign to **customer_persona** if ANY of these match:
- property_format = "Meeting"
- OR property_tags contains “Buyers” or “Non-Buyers”
- OR property_url/property_link is a Fathom/Zoom/Interview recording
- OR content clearly relates to customer interviews or insights

### 3. CIRCADIAN TEACHING (default)
Assign to **circadian_teaching** for everything else:
- Illumination Academy
- Script (non-meeting)
- Blocks (Foundation, Light Mastery, Advanced Integration)
- Behavior Science educational content
- Light science, circadian biology, metabolism, learning modules
- Resources & lessons not related to communication

----------------------------------------------------
OUTPUT SCHEMAS
----------------------------------------------------

=== circadian_teaching ===
{
  "table": "circadian_teaching",
  "id": "",
  "name": "",
  "url": "",
  "format": "",
  "block": "",
  "status": "",
  "type": "",
  "due_date_for_review": "",
  "completion_date": "",
  "completion_due_date": "",
  "assigned_to": [],
  "notes": "",
  "context": "",
  "attendees": "",
  "reference_link": "",
  "database": "",
  "tags": []
}

=== tone_of_voice ===
{
  "table": "tone_of_voice",
  "id": "",
  "name": "",
  "url": "",
  "format": "",
  "status": "",
  "notes": "",
  "context": "",
  "tags": [],
  "reference_link": "",
  "database": ""
}

=== customer_persona ===
{
  "table": "customer_persona",
  "id": "",
  "name": "",
  "url": "",
  "status": "",
  "meeting_url": "",
  "notes": "",
  "context": "",
  "attendees": "",
  "tags": [],
  "assigned_to": []
}

----------------------------------------------------
NORMALIZATION RULES
----------------------------------------------------
- NEVER output null. Convert null → "".
- ALWAYS return an ARRAY of objects.
- If completion_date exists, return the "start" value only.
- Remove empty objects from assigned_to.
- tags must always be an array of strings.
- meeting_url must come from property_url or property_link ONLY for meetings.
- Do not infer or add data.
- Preserve all strings exactly.

----------------------------------------------------
OUTPUT FORMAT
----------------------------------------------------
RETURN ONLY raw JSON. No markdown. No explanations.
